name: Golden Lotus Grand Da Nang
detail: The room was spacious, and the bathroom and amenities were well-equipped, allowing for a comfortable stay. The staff were also friendly, and the cleanliness was very satisfactory. While the accessibility to the airport and shopping environment was somewhat lacking, it is close to the beach, and overall satisfaction for the price is high, so I would recommend it.

name: Canvas Danang Beach Hotel
detail: The room is spacious with plenty of space to comfortably place several large bags. The room is very clean, the bathroom is spacious, and the water pressure is strong. The bed is soft, breakfast is varied and tasty, the swimming pool is very beautiful, and the staff is cheerful and provides excellent service.

name: New Orient Hotel Da Nang
detail: 🇻🇳 Review of New Orient Hotel in Da Nang 🏨✨ For this trip to Da Nang, I chose the New Orient Hotel as my accommodation! First of all, the hotel itself is clean and has a beautiful atmosphere, which made me feel good as soon as I walked in🤍 The room was larger and cleaner than I expected, and the bedding was comfortable, making it great for resting during my travels. What I liked the most was the swimming pool! 🏊🏻‍♀️ The atmosphere of the pool was lovely, and it was a nice place to relax while enjoying the water, making it enjoyable to spend leisurely time at the hotel. The breakfast also had quite a variety, ranging from Vietnamese cuisine to simple menu options, so I could have a hearty meal every morning before heading out🥐🍜 The location is also decent! It was easy to get to Han Market or downtown, and it was a convenient spot for taking Grab rides, making it great for moving around while sightseeing. Additionally, the staff were really friendly, which contributed to a pleasant experience from check-in throughout my stay☺️ Overall, I was satisfied with the room condition, pool, breakfast, and service considering the price! If you're looking for a clean and pretty hotel in Da Nang that isn't too expensive, this is definitely a place worth considering💛

name: Star Near Me Hotel and Spa Danang
detail: It was very comfortable staying there for almost a week from the 13th to the 20th. It's the best for those who just sleep and go out for fun. If you miscalculate the cleaning time, it can be tough. There are always not enough towels.

name: Sea Near Me Hotel Danang
detail: It's day 15 of my trip to Vietnam, starting with a motorcycle trip from Ho Chi Minh City. I was very tired from riding long distances in the rain every day, but this hotel was very well maintained. The bedding was surprisingly clean, and the pool water was spotless as well. Moreover, the staff at the reception, especially Ms. Mi and her colleagues, welcomed me warmly, which made it very easy for us to relax. If I travel to Da Nang again, I definitely plan to stay at this hotel. Thank you for your kindness!

name: SALA DANANG BEACH HOTEL
detail: Dear Sala Danang Beach Hotel, I stayed for three nights with my family. During our stay, it was my birthday, so they prepared a surprise cake in our room, and there were welcome fruits and water every day. The service was excellent. The staff was kind, and in the lobby, there were welcome drinks and free massage chairs. The room was clean, spacious, and comfortable. I had a room with a bathtub, and from the room, I could see beautiful sunrises and sunsets, which made it very relaxing. The breakfast had a lot of variety, including do-it-yourself banh mi, freshly made pho, and steaks grilled right in front of me. It was incredibly convenient being right next to the beach! Everything was close by, and there was a Highland Coffee just a minute's walk away. The rooftop infinity pool was pleasant, and it was a hotel I would love to stay at again. Great value for money and highly recommended!
area: Phước Mỹ,Da Nang - View on map

name: Stella Maris Beach Danang
detail: Although it was not my first time in Da Nang, it was the first time coming with my wife, so I had some expectations for the accommodation. The staff at the reception desk provided kind guidance during check-in, and we received the same room we had booked, which was also modern and well-maintained. Towels, water, coffee, and tea were replenished daily, and the entire room, including the bed, was tidied up simply. Breakfast was available generously until 10 a.m., and I felt that there was enough variety as the menu changed slightly every day, so it did not feel too monotonous. Although the food options were not extensive, they were sufficient, and dishes were quickly replenished as they were emptied. I didn’t use the rooftop pool, but it was nice to enjoy the night view and have a cup of tea with the drink voucher we received at check-in. One downside was that there was a large hotel under construction right next to the beach, which blocked the beach view, and there were occasions when construction work continued late into the night. Overall, I was very satisfied for a 4-star hotel, and I think it would be a good accommodation to recommend in the area unless one is looking for a 5-star hotel. I appreciate the hotel for providing good service during our 4-night stay, ensuring that we had no discomfort.
area: Phước Mỹ,Da Nang - View on map

name: M HOTEL DANANG
detail: I rarely stay at a 5-star hotel, so I was truly impressed. The afternoon tea and breakfast had a wide variety of options, and I ended up eating too much. The room was a deluxe double with a partial sea view, which was spacious, and seeing the sea while in the bathtub was delightful. The hair dryer had strong airflow, making it easy to dry my hair. The elevator hall was spacious with several smoking areas on each floor, which I thought would be comfortable for smokers. The beach is just across the road, and they also lend beach towels. Cleaning was being done in various places from early morning, which is why everything was so tidy. The staff were all polite, smiling, and pleasant! I couldn't speak English, but it wasn't a problem. And the pool—it's truly an infinity pool! It wasn't too crowded, allowing for a relaxed time. The Dragon Bridge, Marble Mountains, and beach were all clearly visible. The view was amazing. Considering the price, it felt so inexpensive. I'm really glad I stayed here. Thank you very much!

name: Moonlight Hotel Da Nang - Near Dragon Bridge
detail: Moonlight Hotel has a very beautiful location in the center of Da Nang. I stayed in a room on a high floor with an impressive view, overlooking the Han River and Dragon Bridge, especially stunning at night when the city lights up beautifully. The room is clean, airy, with a comfortable bed and all the necessary amenities. The staff are friendly, enthusiastic, and provide quick support. The room rates are reasonable considering the location and quality. It was a very worthwhile experience, and next time I come to Da Nang, I will definitely return to Moonlight!
